facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Jim was on the ship now. He chose to find the treasure. It was a big choice. Jim faced a hard choice.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Jim sailed across the wide ocean on the Hispaniola. He thought about his choice to leave home. It was scary, but Jim wanted adventure. Sometimes making a choice means you cannot go back. Jim faced a hard choice. Jim hoped his choice was the right one.
facts.Page story text 3 (draft, teacher check: As the Hispaniola sailed farther from land, Jim began to wonder about his decision. He could have stayed safe at home, but instead he chose the unknown sea. Making choices is never easy, especially when you are young. Jim faced a hard choice. However, Jim realized that not choosing is also a choice. Because he wanted to discover something greater, he pushed his fears aside. Every great adventure begins with one brave decision. Jim was determined to see this journey through to the end.
facts.Word cards: faced = 직면했다 / choice = 선택 / troubled = 걱정되는 / dilemma = 딜레마
